decisions.reason: After several years, continued retention would indicate bleaching tray blanks are meeting at least acceptable aspiration levels in the core dental materials business, so we would keep them while using existing manufacturing and distribution slack.

The PETG thermoforming blank fits established laboratory workflows and, if still sold by 2022, likely delivers results close enough to aspirations to justify continued offering rather than reallocating resources.

Because this lacquer was only weakly featured from the start and is less central to the firm's digital and custom-device trajectory, a mature shortfall versus aspirations would now justify redeploying resources to stronger lines and new development.

The intraoral contrast spray supports digital and clinical workflows that are strategically important for the firm, so a large established company would usually keep it unless performance clearly fell below aspirations.

Custom earmolds are closely aligned with the firm's hearing-care customer base and custom manufacturing capabilities, and surviving to this point suggests performance sufficient to remain on the market despite periodic portfolio review.
